subject: RFP: Legal questionnaire — IP, indemnity, liability cap, order form
messages:
From: Maria Santos <maria.santos@stellarbio.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@stellarbio.com
Date: Sun, 9 Aug 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: RFP: Legal questionnaire — IP / Liability clarifications

Hi Aditya,

Thanks again for the demo last week. As part of our formal RFP we need to clarify a handful of legal points in the questionnaire attached. Can you please confirm Redwood's position on the following so we can move this to our commercial team?

1) IP ownership: for model outputs produced from our customer data, does StellarBio retain ownership of those outputs? Do you require any assignment or license back for customer-generated content or model fine-tuning artifacts?

2) Indemnity: is Redwood willing to provide IP infringement indemnity for third-party claims related to the hosted inference service? Any carve-outs?

3) Liability cap: StellarBio's procurement prefers a liability cap of $5,000,000 or the amount paid in the prior 12 months, whichever is greater. Can Redwood accommodate this, or do you propose an alternative?

4) Order form / payment terms: please provide your standard order form template and confirm whether your standard payment and termination terms can be negotiated at the order-form level.

Target: we'd like written answers by EOD Wed (11 Aug) so commercial can draft the redlines. If you prefer to route legal directly, please cc them.

Thanks,

Maria Santos
Senior Procurement Manager
StellarBio
[Attachment: RFP_Legal_Questionnaire_StellarBio.pdf (pdf, 120KB)]

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Maria Santos <maria.santos@stellarbio.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 9 Aug 2026 18:02:13 -0700
Subject: Re: RFP: Legal questionnaire — IP / Liability clarifications

Thanks Maria — appreciate the clear list. Looping in our legal lead (Laura) and product/legal PM (Lauren) to give definitive answers.

Laura / Lauren — Stellarbio has asked for clarifications on IP for model outputs, IP indemnity, a $5M liability cap, and an order-form template. They need answers by EOD Wed 11 Aug. Can you confirm whether we can provide the standard positions below or if you want to propose redlines:

- Customer owns customer data and customer-derived outputs; Redwood retains underlying model IP and pre-existing model weights.
- Redwood provides IP infringement indemnity for claims arising out of our service (standard carve-outs for open-source model provenance where applicable).
- Standard liability cap is 12 months of fees (or $2M floor); need guidance if we can move to $5M or a negotiated number for larger deals.

Happy to set up a 30-min sync if that helps.

—Aditya
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0124

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Maria Santos <maria.santos@stellarbio.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: RFP: Legal questionnaire — IP / Liability clarifications

Aditya / Lauren —

Thanks for the ping, Maria. Below are Redwood's proposed responses and the rationale. I've attached an annotated questionnaire doc with redlineable language for your procurement team.

1) IP ownership / outputs
- Proposed answer: StellarBio will retain ownership of Customer Data and any Outputs produced solely from Customer Data. Redwood retains ownership of pre-existing models, model weights, and any general purpose improvements based on aggregated telemetry that are not traceable to Customer Data.
- If StellarBio requests transfer/assignment of model modifications or fine-tuned weights, we are open to discussing a licensing or commercial arrangement, but we do not assign core model IP as a standard.

2) Indemnity
- Proposed answer: Redwood will indemnify Customer for third-party claims alleging that the Service, as delivered by Redwood, directly infringes a third party's patents, copyrights, or trade secrets, subject to the standard conditions (prompt notice, right to control defense, cooperation).
- Carve-outs: any material contributed by Customer, or claims arising from Customer-provided prompts/data that introduce third-party content, are excluded. Claims arising from open-source model components will be evaluated case-by-case depending on provenance.

3) Liability cap
- Proposed answer: Redwood's standard commercial cap is the greater of (i) amount paid by Customer to Redwood in the prior 12 months and (ii) $2,000,000. For enterprise customers with committed spend above $X, we can consider higher caps on a negotiated basis.
- Exception: no cap for gross negligence or willful misconduct; regulatory penalties and indemnities for third-party IP claims may also be carved out where required by law.

4) Order form / payment terms
- Proposed answer: Order forms are the primary commercial instrument; many payment/termination terms can be negotiated at the order-form level. We will provide the standard order form template and an editable SOW.

Attachments included: annotated questionnaire with suggested language and a sample order form template. If StellarBio needs us to accept a $5M cap we should understand the scope (is it aggregate across all claims?) and whether there is a corresponding commitment (minimum annual spend or longer term commitment).

Proposed next step: Aditya — send the attached packet to Maria with a short cover note and propose a 30-min call on Wed (11 Aug) to walk through any material redlines.

Laura Bennett
Head of Legal, Contracts & Compliance
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Annotated-Questionnaire-answers.docx (docx, 85KB)]

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: RFP: Legal questionnaire — IP / Liability clarifications

Hi Maria —

Thanks for the note and the questionnaire. Per our legal team (see excerpt below), please find our formal responses and attached template documents.

Key points up front:
- Ownership: StellarBio retains ownership of Customer Data and Outputs generated from your data. Redwood retains underlying model IP and pre-existing weights.
- Indemnity: Redwood will indemnify for third-party IP infringement claims tied to the service, with customary cooperation and exclusions for Customer-contributed content and open-source provenance issues.
- Liability cap: Our starter position is the greater of 12 months of paid fees or $2,000,000. We are open to consideration of $5,000,000 for enterprise customers with corresponding committed spend; please confirm if StellarBio expects the $5M as a hard cap or as an aspirational target tied to an ARR or term commitment.

Attached: Redwood_RFP_Response_StellarBio.pdf (consolidated answers), OrderForm-Template-Redwood.docx (editable), Annotated-Questionnaire-answers.docx (legal redlines).

Would you be available for a 30-minute call on Wed 11 Aug at 11:00 AM PT to walk the answers and identify any must-haves? If that time doesn't work, propose a slot and we'll accommodate.

Quoted from Laura for reference:
> "Redwood's standard commercial cap is the greater of (i) amount paid by Customer to Redwood in the prior 12 months and (ii) $2,000,000. For enterprise customers with committed spend above $X, we can consider higher caps on a negotiated basis."

Best,
